scientific_integrity: The proof is elementary finite-field incidence geometry. Exhaustive checks are illustrative; the universal formulas follow from conic counts, a nodal cubic projection, and an exact quadratic-character sum. Tangent contact points are counted rather than distinct tangent lines.
scientific_limitations: Only rational contact points and exterior points of the displayed singular plane model, in characteristic greater than three. Priority may be affected by unindexed equivalent arithmetic incidence tables. No independent external verification.
title: Complete exterior tangent-contact spectrum of a tangent-filling plane curve
